scope: Boomerang inherited native shield bounce; shared area-entry defense guards with existing native ranged and source-flagged pet projectiles.
rules: No damage, on-hit or life steal on an active shield entry; no permanent damage-ignore insertion for an absorbed hit.
Inherited bounce consumes target RNG and decrements even a zero/negative budget; positive damage is truncated with minimum1 and knockback removed.
Independent Out/Apex/Back trajectory, carrier tracking, cooldown lock and maximum4s lifetime survive reflection. No ordinary projectile range extension is applied to the phase path.
Zero-speed bounce retains signed-zero components: atan2 can yield0 or +/-pi. Collider rotation follows this inherited velocity angle, then resumes existing spin.

Separate defender overlap state survives damage-ignore clearing between flight legs. A previous damage hit does not prevent a later shield entry. Multiple defenders retain independent overlap entries.
interfaces: NativeProjectileDefense.Adapter: active->active/capable, target->optional world X/Z, overlaps->live circle overlap. Existing BrotatoProjectile.setDefense remains the installation entry point.
Defense.refresh/candidate/enter share area-entry guards; enter checks live activity immediately before resolution. Defense.direction shares global target/random fallback semantics.
Boomerang per-shot rotation and bounce counter stay server-internal. No remote, profile schema or Arsenal change.
